import ctypes
import os

# Load the required libraries
libgslcblas_path = "/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so"
libgsl_path = "/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so"

ctypes.CDLL(libgslcblas_path, mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL(libgsl_path)

# Define the gsl_sf_result structure
class GslSfResult(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [
        ("val", ctypes.c_double),
        ("err", ctypes.c_double)
    ]

# Define the gsl_sf_bessel_Y0 function
# double gsl_sf_bessel_Y0(const double x);
gsl.gsl_sf_bessel_Y0.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double]
gsl.gsl_sf_bessel_Y0.restype = ctypes.c_double

def bessel_Y0(x):
    """Compute the Bessel function of the second kind Y0(x) using GSL."""
    if not isinstance(x, (int, float)):
        raise TypeError("Input must be a number.")
    if x <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Input must be positive.")
    return gsl.gsl_sf_bessel_Y0(ctypes.c_double(x))
